evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 39 (check 38): 'Scored dimension prompts tell the judge to score each criterion on its own and continue after a failure (one miss can't zero the rest). Gate dimensions are exempt.' Deterministic sheet row 5: check-batched-independence-wording.py - stop-on-first-failure wording is a FAIL; all_pass gates exempt. Skill quality-checks.md:156-159 same. Checker not present in workspace, applied manually (not a checker run). All three scored dimensions are mode='batched' (judge.toml line 3) and each prompt carries explicit independence + continue wording: functional/prompt.md:13 'Once it succeeds, score EACH criterion independently, continue after failures and keep successful observations. A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row. Shared protocols reduce setup; they are not conjunctive bundles. When a setup step fails, set up the same thing again on a new job of your own...'; functional/prompt.md:7 'give that criterion its lowest score ... and move on'; polish/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise judge each criterion independently and continue after failures.'; visual/prompt.md:12 'Otherwise grade every criterion independently with its five anchors and continue after failures.' The only all-or-nothing rule in each scored prompt is the in-dimension browser gate (functional:13, polish:12, visual:12), which the template also has and row 29 requires. Per-step failure rules are scoped to the criterion: 'A step you skipped or did differently fails that criterion' (functional:25, polish:22, visual:18); tool failures become per-outcome 'NOT EXERCISED' with 'Preserve every completed independent observation' (functional:61, polish:26, visual:20). No stop/abort/first-failure/fail-fast wording anywhere in scored prompts, judge.toml criteria or app_context.md (grep). The template's 'Fail fast ... stop and fail that criterion, then continue the rest' line is not carried into the task. Cross-row cascades are actively prevented with ownership notes in criteria (e.g. hro_candidate_linked 'rows run on his seeded conversation instead are not reduced for it'; prompt.md:47 fallback to Tomas's seeded conversation; hro_activity_refusals sole owner of refused-action lines; hro_status_codes counts only refused replays). Gates: gates/render/judge.toml:15 and gates/constraints/judge.toml:15 aggregation='all_pass' - exempt. Colderwater lessons bearing on this row checked: lesson 9 (report each step, skipped step fails) is present but scoped per criterion, so it does not zero siblings; lesson 7/14 timed observations are per-attempt void/repeat rules with no cascade; lesson 16 (no double grading) ownership notes present. Adversarial: a broken app with one failing feature (e.g. undo) cannot zero unrelated rows by prompt instruction; a conforming app cannot be zeroed by a judge told to stop early. Observation for the owner (not a row-38 wording defect, belongs to rows 28/40): functional:15 requires 'your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol' and the setup fallback at :13 is only 'if that is possible without the broken feature', so an app whose job-opening or add-candidate flow fails would lose nearly all board rows through product dependency rather than prompt wording; hro_candidate_no_staff also fails when 'the staff control did not succeed', coupling it to other rows' features. Run evidence: raw-evidence-index scope says full configured grading is absent, so no judge transcript shows the batched judge actually continuing after a failure; this row is a source-wording check owned by a deterministic checker and the wording is met.
